spots.text: REST HERE. THE STAIR WILL STILL BE THERE.

secrets.name: The Cell in the Wall
secrets.text: Behind the bookcase, a low door, and a cell just big enough for a bed. Someone lived here long enough to wear a hollow in the pillow, and left the candle for you.

meta.label: The Well of Stairs
meta.blurb: A stair goes round and round the inside of a well, and every so often it passes a landing with chairs, as if it expected you to need a rest. Far below, the lamps shrink to a single point and do not stop.
